Hi Sam — thanks for the note and the screenshot.

Short answer: I can investigate and, if needed, trigger a manual grant while we confirm why the self-serve path failed. Occasionally corporate domains or certain email reputation signals will trigger an "authorization hold" on promo issuance which prevents the automatic credit grant.

Can you confirm whether you used the invite link directly from the website or signed up via a SSO/SAML flow? Also: any chance the team used multiple accounts (personal + company) when they signed up?

I'll loop in our billing/ops engineer to check the account activity and make a manual grant if appropriate.

Best,

Subject: Re: Fwd: Free credits not reflected after signup — authorization hold?

Thanks for the heads up. I pulled the account activity for acct_0a9b3c and confirmed an authorization hold was placed by the promo-guard workflow because sparklabs.ai matched a conservative reputation rule (automated filter). The hold prevented the PLG2026 grant job from applying credits.

What I did:
- Manually issued 500 free credits to acct_0a9b3c via the admin grant tool (txn id: grant_20260531_879b).
- Cleared the hold for this account; the automatic grant job is still gated by the promo-guard until we adjust the rule.
- Attached a short excerpt from the audit log showing the hold and the manual grant (audit_log_excerpt.csv).

Action items for internal follow-up:
1) Rishi: decide whether we loosen the reputation threshold for PLG2026 (and document exceptions).
2) Product/Ops: add telemetry to the self-serve flow to surface hold reasons in the UI so customers see "Pending verification" rather than a blank balance.
3) Marissa: confirm with Spark Labs that credits are visible to them and we can close the ticket.

Sam — can you refresh your dashboard and confirm you see a 500-credit balance now? If not, tell me the browser + any extensions and I'll keep digging.

—Dev
